trends.name: Iran Escalation & Hormuz Disruption Risk
trends.summary: Iran rejected U.S. demands and refused negotiations in Pakistan as ceasefire talks reached 'dead end.' U.S. fighter jet shot down with crew member rescued; missile launches detected toward Israel. Wall Street bracing for longer-term oil-gas disruption with potential Strait of Hormuz implications affecting energy markets and inflation.

trends.name: Massive Hedge Fund Short Positioning
trends.summary: Hedge funds sold global equities at fastest pace in 10 years during March with short-to-long ratio of 7.6:1.0. Fourth consecutive monthly sale signals extreme bearish positioning. This represents significant market-timing risk if sentiment reverses.

trends.name: March Jobs Report: Mixed Signals
trends.summary: U.S. nonfarm payrolls beat expectations with 178,000 jobs added in March; unemployment held at 4.3%. However, multiple analysts flagged hidden weakness in participation rates and underlying metrics. Market interpreting as neither strongly hawkish nor dovish for Fed policy.

trends.name: Trump Defense Spending Surge & Budget
trends.summary: Trump's new budget seeks historic increase to defense spending alongside $1 trillion spending hike over 2025. Defense ETFs and contractors positioned to benefit from geopolitical tensions and budget allocation shift.

trends.name: SpaceX IPO Countdown & Satellite Industry
trends.summary: Investor enthusiasm building for SpaceX IPO as Amazon and SpaceX accelerate satellite deployment. Related chip stocks gaining attention as satellite-internet infrastructure buildout accelerates. Supply chain and semiconductor beneficiaries emerging.

trends.name: Section 230 Legal Shield Under Attack
trends.summary: Meta and Google facing court cases that bypass 30-year-old Section 230 legal protections. Represents major regulatory and litigation risk for big tech. Potential for significant compliance costs and liability exposure.

trends.name: USD/JPY Strengthens on BoJ Rate Hike Pricing
trends.summary: USD/JPY under pressure as markets price in Bank of Japan rate hike expectations. Currency volatility implications for multinational earnings and carry trade unwinding risks.

trends.name: Gen Z Abandoning Traditional Financial Goals
trends.summary: Generation Z increasingly rejecting home ownership, traditional savings, and linear careers in favor of immediate spending and riskier financial behavior. Structural shift in consumer behavior and asset demand implications for housing, banking, and consumer sectors.

trends.name: Oil & Gas Producer Recovery Play
trends.summary: Wall Street rotating into lagging oil-and-gas producers amid Iran escalation and supply disruption concerns. Energy sector positioning as geopolitical hedge with commodity upside from potential Hormuz disruption.

trends.name: Inflation Concerns Return for Retirees
trends.summary: Jobs data and Iran war rekindling inflation fears particularly for retirees on fixed income. Rising fuel prices ($4 gas, private aviation up 20%) driving cost-of-living pressures and portfolio allocation concerns.

trends.name: Salesforce & Agentic AI Leadership
trends.summary: Salesforce positioned as major beneficiary of agentic AI trend with strong Rule of 44 outperformance metrics. Upgrade to Buy reflects AI monetization tailwinds in enterprise software sector.

trends.name: Wall Street Breaks 5-Week Losing Streak
trends.summary: Market sentiment shifted to 'cautiously optimistic' after ending five-week losing streak. Goldman Strategists moving from 'headline fatigue' to recovery positioning, though massive hedge fund short positioning suggests fragility.
